concept: The man who owns Mill Street: enormous, bald and bearded, red velvet smoking jacket over a straining white vest, heavy gold chains and sovereign rings, cigar, black trousers and shiny shoes. Grabs you by the collar and slams you over his shoulder; swats with huge backhands. The final boss.

generator.mode: PixelLab v3, 96px canvas, side view, facing right, native size (set target_height to the base's real height, scale 1.0). Generate the base in the fighting stance and use it as the start frame for every animation.
generator.prompt: enormous bald bearded crime landlord, red velvet smoking jacket over a straining white vest, heavy gold chains, gold sovereign rings, cigar in his mouth, black trousers, shiny black shoes, menacing fighting stance with huge hands open, full body, detailed 32-bit pixel art, clean dark outline

animation_notes.grab: lunges forward and grabs with both hands at chest height

idle.note: raw/pixellab/idle frames 0-5-1 ping-pong (6-8 turn toward the camera), padded (6,2) onto the 108x128 knockdown canvas so frame 0 lines up with knockdown frame 0

walk.note: raw/pixellab/walk frames 1-8 (0 is the stance start frame)

windup.note: raw/pixellab/slam frames 1-4: raises both fists overhead, over the 0.4 s windup_time

slam.note: raw/pixellab/slam frames 5-6 (overhead), 7 (the smash hits), 8 held: 0.58 s with the hit at 0.17-0.25 s, the old slam's timing. Third take, generated from the stance padded to 112x136 for headroom; the first two never got the fists above the head

hurt.note: raw/pixellab/knockdown frames 1-2-3-2-1: the backward stagger before the fall (the v3 hurt turned to face the camera)

getup.note: raw/pixellab/getup frames 1-10; generated from knockdown frame 10 to the stance padded onto the same 108x128 canvas

grab.note: raw/pixellab/grab frames 1-6: lunges in and holds both hands at chest height (7-8 had white ring artefacts); held through grab_hold_time
